item.title: Version 0.9.3
item.description:
What's New

  • Pro: follow the system Now Playing source in the music layer, including compatible players beyond Spotify and Apple Music.
  • Drag one display onto another in Overview to copy its wallpaper setup.

Improvements

  • Library pages scroll beneath their filter and count bars, with clearer filters, empty results and context menus.
  • Rename displays from the arrangement or Settings, and apply schemes and Workshop items to a named display from their menus.
  • Simplify music visuals and process-widget sizing; put wallpaper updates in the detail header.

Bug Fixes

  • Keep cancelled display drags cancelled until mouse-up, and keep covered display controls from handling input.
  • Retry failed cover captures safely and improve persistence, export cleanup and variable-font handling.
  • Keep system media commands ordered and stop polling when the music source closes.
  • Verify update archives against the app's existing Sparkle public key before publishing them.

Not notarized — if macOS refuses to open the app, run xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine "/Applications/Loomscreen Pro.app" once; updates Loomscreen Pro installs itself clear the flag. Full release notes · 完整发布说明
